what: Short word lines are wrapped around the X axis on the front half turn (180° ÷ count spacing) of a cylinder with radius (screen width ÷ 4.8). With the section pinned (default 2500px), scrolling rolls the cylinder from −80° to 270° with scrub 1, so words rise from below and tip over the top. The back face is hidden (backface hidden).

options.radius: Radius relative to screen width, default 1/4.8 → .2083
options.[data-fx-part=drum]: Cylinder (child) — if absent, the element itself rolls

from.where: index.js dark section .bp-drum — original business_items: y=width/4.8·sin(t·π/n), z=width/4.8·cos(t·π/n), rotateX −t·180/n, fixed +2500 scrub 1 rotateX −80→270(2)
